meaning: This analysis uses planned timetable data, not real-time AVL or GTFS-Realtime vehicle positions.
Longer scheduled inter-stop times can indicate expected congestion, but they are not direct observed delay.
The feed does not include boardings, alightings, crowding, Leap Card taps, or APC data.
The feed does not show TSP requests, signal phases, or intersection delay directly.
Use the outputs as planning and ITS design evidence, then recommend AVL/RTPI/GTFS-RT integration for actual performance monitoring.
